test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 29 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7446b19c88fb6df12f9f6dba8ff71a3966b1173de59b3363e9a18945fc55e466.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The first two elements of left diagonal elements interchange positions.

The last two elements of left diagonal elements interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecb362fde1d8d8a3cb1928f4258b696bb496ab404dff95010fdf52d525bdf7da.png] 

2) Second box series →

The elements at the corner shift clockwise subsequently.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/526643cbf0514373bf20278770181a361cfed772e1723adb2d48568efb805266.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c94a18eb705fd3e043abb454164e2023dd4769880d07a0591c44aa5e0956b559.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
